profile.name: Pritam
profile.tagline: ECE @ DCRUST | Firmware, FPGAs, Edge ML
profile.shortBio: Second-year ECE student at DCRUST building at the boundary of firmware and machine learning. I write C/C++ for microcontrollers, design FPGA watchdogs for CubeSats, and run diffusion models inside 4 GB of VRAM.

about.fullBio:
I'm a second-year ECE student at DCRUST, Sonipat, studying electronics but spending most of my time writing firmware and building systems that sit at the edge of hardware and ML.

My work tends to involve tight constraints. At PCB CUPID I worked on Circuit Spell, an AI agent that turns natural language into full PCB designs — schematics, routed layouts, Gerber exports — while prototyping the EDA subsystems underneath it. Before that, I built XIO-SAT: a fault-tolerant CubeSat guardian node where an SLG47910 FPGA watchdog monitors a 4-node stack and guarantees hard reboot within 1.5s of any fault.

I also built Synapse, a local multimodal pipeline chaining a VLM, CLIP-based retrieval, and a diffusion model inside 4 GB of VRAM. The constraint was the point — figuring out how to fit real ML inference on hardware that isn't supposed to do it.

experience.title: Embedded Application Developer (Intern)
description: Co-built Circuit Spell (spell.pcbcupid.com) from ideation: an AI agent that converts natural language into full PCB designs using 50+ proprietary Glyph modules, generating schematics, routed layouts, and 3D views exportable in Gerber/KiCad/PDF.
Prototyped core EDA subsystems: constraint-based component placement and auto-routing, de-risking the architecture before the production build.
Engineered multi-sensor IoT firmware in C/C++ on Glyph boards (C2, C6, H2) with interrupt-driven scheduling for high-precision industrial control tasks.

experience.title: Robotics Engineering Team Member & Mentor
description: Architected and built autonomous line-following robots using Arduino, achieving 95% path accuracy on complex competition tracks.
Led and mentored 15+ junior developers on embedded systems, PID control, and algorithm design.
